feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 4 August 2026 6:18am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

SE 4 or 5, veering South this morning, then South or SW 4 or 5 this afternoon and evening, occasionally touching 6 in places for a time in the late afternoon and evening. Veering West 4 or 5 early tonight, increasing West or SW 5 or 6 later in night.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate tonight.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle and areas of mist this morning, then becoming fair later this morning or afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor at times at first, then generally good from this afternoon onwards.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds, possibly gales.


##Wind)##

West or SW 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 by about midday, then possibly touching gale 8 in places later in the day (most likely to north of island). Veering West or NW overnight and decreasing 5 or 6.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough for a time.


##Weather)##

Scattered showers, rain for a time in places.


##Visibility)##

Mostly good, possibly moderate in showers or rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Thursday, 6 August 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

West or NW 5 or 6, gradually decreasing 3 or 4 through the day, backing SW overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, falling slight.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair, scattered showers for a time.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Friday, 7 August 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

West or SW 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Saturday, 8 August 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

West or SW 4 or 5.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Fair, then rain later in day/ overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Temperature##
